body:
Hey guys, I have the nebula map done :D. It has some pretty cool hidden things in it

 Teams White Vs Blue

Default Items: Iron Sword, 2 golden apples, 1 Diamond Pick, 32 Oak Logs, 16 Steak, 1 Infinity Bow, 1 Arrow, 64 Glass.

Armour: (White Team: Iron Boots White dyed Leggings, Chestplate, and helmet.) (Blue Team: Iron Boots Blue dyed Leggings, Chestplate, and Helmet.)

Thx for the feedback!
Download I know it says mineshaft but that was the original name.
https://www.mediafire.com/?ko59dp3vaee41n4
